entries.name: Argonians
entries.content: Argonians, also known as Saxhleel in their own native language, are reptilian humanoids who originate from the region of Black Marsh, a swampy region in the south east of Tamriel. Argonians have bodies similar to the average human, with females having defined breasts and feminine figures. Argonians have reptilian, lizard-like heads and tails, skin covered in fine scales, and their fingers and toes end in small claws. Many argonians have small horns, fins, or quills on their heads, which they often decorate and style in the same way humans may style their hair. While argonians prefer warm climates, they can be found all over Tamriel, and are very hardy. Argonians are excellent swimmers, able to hold their breaths for long periods of time. Argonians are very resistant to poisons and disease. Argonians tend to be antagonistic towards Khajiit, and have a general distrust of Dark Elves, due to the long history of Dark Elves abducting and enslaving Argonians from Black Marsh.

entries.name: Skyrim
entries.content: Skyrim is the northernmost province of the Empire on Tamriel, and the traditional home of the Nords. Skyrim is bordered by high, rugged mountains to the south, east, and west, and the frigid Sea of Ghosts to the north. The climate of Skyrim ranges from temperate forests in the south, marshlands to the west, large grasslands in the interior, and frozen tundra and glaciers in the north. Winters are very harsh and local settlements are fortified against the cold. Many dangerous monsters and wild beasts roam the lands of Skyrim, making travel dangerous at times. The native Nords are distrustful of outsiders, especially of the elven races. Skyrim is ruled by a High King, but is currently part of the Empire of Cyrodiil. After the war against the high elf Altmeri Dominion and the Empire, a civil war is starting in Skyrim between those loyal to the Empire, and the Stormcloak Rebellion made up of Nords who wish to leave the Empire. Many ancient ruins and tombs are scattered across Skyrim, holding treasures and artifacts which attract many adventurers to Skyrim.

entries.name: Nords
entries.content: Nords, also known as Northmen, are humans native to the province of Skyrim. Nords are a hardy people, adapted to the harsh climate of Skyrim. They are tall with fair skin and facial hair is common among Nord men. Nords are generally well muscled, and are on average taller and broader than most other humans. Nords traditionally venerate animal totems and ancient gods, though most accept the common religion of the Empire. Many Nords are loyal to the Empire, and make up a large part of the Imperial Legion, though a growing number of Nords have become disloyal to the Empire and join the Stormcloak Rebellion to make Skyrim leave the Empire. Nords tend to be distrustful of outsiders, especially elves, but are fiercely loyal to their friends and family. Nords are generally wary of magic, and can be very superstitious, though some do still learn and use magic. Nords are very resistant to cold and cold-based magic, and are accustomed to the harsh conditions and dangerous wildlife of Skyrim.

entries.name: Imperials
entries.content: Imperials, also known as Cyrodilics, are humans native to the central province of Cyrodiil. They are of average build for humans, with no real outstanding physical qualities. Imperials are descendants of the humans that overthrew the elven Ayleids thousands of years ago and formed the first Empire of Tamriel. Imperials are a cosmopolitan race, believing in civilization, order, and cultural refinement. While they do make up a large portion of the Imperial Legion, Imperials in general are welcoming of other races that share an appreciation for law and order. While their home of Cyrodiil is a pastoral land, Imperials are very adaptable, and can be found all throughout the lands of Tamriel. The recent war with the elven Altmeri Dominion has made many Imperials distrustful of elves, particularly High Elves, due to the prolonged war and atrocities committed against Imperial citizens by the elven invaders.

entries.name: High Elves
entries.content: High Elves, also known as the Altmer, originate from the Summerset Isles, a large island to the southwest of mainland Tamriel. High Elves are tall, slim, and golden skinned elves with delicate features and pointed ears. They are often seen as aloof and arrogant by other races. High Elves generally believe themselves to be superior to other races, even among other elven races. While not physically strong, High Elves in general have a talent for magic, and many become powerful mages and spellcasters. While many elves are welcoming of other races, many more see themselves as better than other races, especially the races of humans and beastkin like Argonians and Khajiit. The ruling government of the Summerset Isles was recently overthrown by a group known as the Altmeri Dominion, which has taken control of the province, and started a protracted war with the Empire, resulting in widespread conflict. Due to this, High Elves, and elves in general, are generally distrusted in Skyrim, particularly by the members of the Stormcloak Rebellion.

entries.name: Dark Elves
entries.content: Dark Elves, also known as Dunmer, are a race of grey-skinned elves native to the province of Morrowind in the north east region of Tamriel. A race of outcast elves known for their worship of daedra, the Dark Elves have often found themselves in conflict with the other races. Dark Elves are tall and slight of build, with dark hair and red eyes. Their home of Morrowind is a harsh, alien land, populated by bizarre wildlife and dominated by a massive volcano known as the Red Mountain. The recent eruption of the Red Mountain has covered much of Morrowind in ash, rendering it uninhabitable, and has forced many Dark Elves to seek refuge in other provinces, including Skyrim, where they face racial persecution. In the past, the Dark Elves of Morrowind have had a history of raiding the other provinces for slaves, particularly the Argonians of Black Marsh to their south. This has caused Argonians and Dark Elves to be very distrusting of each other, and resulted in an Argonian invasion of Morrowind shortly after the eruption of Red Mountain, as vengeance for centuries of slavery.

entries.name: Wood Elves
entries.content: Wood Elves, or Bosmer as they are sometimes called, are a race of short, tanned elves native to the dense forests and jungles of the province of Valenwood in the south west of Tamriel. They are shorter than most other races, not particularly strong but very agile. They have a strong connection with nature, and are often seen as uncivilized by the other elven races, particularly the High Elves. Wood Elf women are slightly taller than the men. Wood Elves tend to keep to themselves and are generally friendly to most other races. With the rise of the elven Altmeri Dominion, Valenwood has been taken over by a coup, and so many Wood Elves find themselves as unwilling servants of the Altmeri Dominion.

entries.name: Khajiit
entries.content: Khajiit are a race of cat-like feline humanoids from the province of Elsweyr in the south of Tamriel. Elsweyr is made up of dense jungles and vast deserts. Khajiit have bodies resembling humans, but covered in thick fur. They have feline heads, long tails, and prominent claws on their hands and feet. Khajiit are on average about the size of a typical human, but far more agile. Many Khajiit make a name for themselves as spies and thieves. As such, they are often distrusted by the other races, particularly by Argonians who have a natural distrust for them. Some Khajiit become wandering merchants, traveling the different provinces selling whatever they happen to collect on the way. Khajiit have a particular weakness for a drug called Skooma, which is refined from a substance known as Moon Sugar. Many Khajiit become addicts, and can be easily tempted by offering them a small amount of Skooma.

entries.name: Bretons
entries.content: Bretons are a race of humans from the province of Highrock in the north west of Tamriel. Also sometimes called Manmer or Half-Elves, they are a half-breed mix of human and elf. This has resulted in them being on average shorter and not as strong as most humans, but has given them some amount of magical talent. They are often seen as weaker than other human races, but are well respected for their magical abilities.

entries.name: Redguard
entries.content: Redguards, also called Yokudan in their own dialect, are a race of tall, dark-skinned humans from the province of Hammerfell in the western region of Tamriel. Hammerfell is dominated by vast deserts, and Redguards have adapted to the dry, arid environment. They are naturally very athletic and resilient, though tend to not be as clever or magically inclined as other races.

entries.name: Orcs
entries.content: Orcs, also known as Orsimer, are a race of tall, powerful green-skinned people originally descended from elves. Originally native to regions of Highrock and Hammerfell, Orcs are an outcast race, and have become scattered all across Tamriel. Orcs are large and heavily muscled in general, with green skin, pointed ears, and dark hair. Their most prominent feature are the large tusks on their lower jaw, which gives them a menacing appearance. Orcs are often seen as barbaric and uncivilized by other races, however they can become fiercely loyal to those that earn their trust. Many Orcs become valued members of the Imperial Legion, where they use their great strength and resilience to become formidable soldiers.
